facts.text: Gina and Jon both enjoy contemporary dance as a form of stress relief and personal expression.

evidence.quote: Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.
I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful!

facts.text: Jon has been dancing since childhood and considers it a passion and escape.

evidence.quote: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape.

facts.text: Jon plans to start a dance studio to teach others the joy of dancing.

evidence.quote: I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.

facts.text: Gina and Jon plan to attend a dance class together.

evidence.quote: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!
